name: benchmaker
description: Build benchmarks of hard agent tasks that admit only verified, shortcut-resistant tasks and measure how well the suite separates systems.

interface.shortDescription: Build hard-task benchmarks with measured quality.
interface.longDescription: Source hard tasks, admit only those that pass a blind audit, an adversary and calibration, measure the suite against comparison systems, and report a quality card with honest gaps.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use benchmaker to build a benchmark of hard tasks for my agent, skill or workflow.
